decisions.reason: No evidence of performance shortfall relative to aspirations and ample slack support keeping this close-to-core quarter-pallet display.
The pegboard-back display remains close to the established offer and shows no signals of falling below aspiration, so a large firm with slack would retain it.
As a quarter-pallet display similar to existing products, it likely meets aspirations, and slack allows continued carrying absent a clear shortfall.
The eighth-pallet display fits the firm's core cardboard display competencies and has no apparent aspiration shortfall, so dropping is unlikely.
Although the wooden pallet is a somewhat larger departure from cardboard displays, slack and the absence of negative performance signals favor keeping it under review.
